source_excerpt: def apply_non_ml_policy(actions: pd.DataFrame, policy: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray: side = actions["side"].astype(str).to_numpy() spread = actions["spread_ticks"].astype(float).to_numpy() kind = policy["policy_type"] if kind == "spread_only": return spread >= float(policy["min_spread_ticks"]) if kind == "bid_only_spread": return (side == "bid") & (spread >= float(policy["min_spread_ticks"])) if kind == "side_specific_spread_threshold": return np.where( side == "bid", spread >= float(policy["bid_min_spread_ticks"]), spread >= float(policy["ask_min_spread_ticks"]), ) if kind == "side_spread_bucket_lut": buckets = actions["spread_bucket"].astype(str).to_numpy() lut = policy["quote_lut"] return np.asarray([bool(lut.get(f"{s}|{b}", False)) for s, b in zip(side, buckets)], dtype=bool) raise ValueError(f"Unknown non-ML policy: {kind}")
